About Me

I am a freelance Full-Stack Developer based in Meerut, Uttar Pradesh, India. I specialize in building highly scalable, performant web applications using React.js and Java Spring Boot.

As the Co-Founder & CTO of CodeByte, and an active developer affiliated with the IIMT University Incubation Center, I help startups and businesses bring their products to life. I have delivered over 20+ successful projects ranging from ed-tech and medical logistics platforms to real-time financial services and AI-driven security systems.

Technical Skills

  • Frontend: React.js, Next.js, JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, CSS3, Tailwind CSS, Responsive Design
  • Backend & API: Java, Spring Boot, Microservices, Node.js, Express, RESTful APIs, WebSockets
  • Databases & Cloud: MySQL, SQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, Docker, Git, Cloud Architecture
  • Security & Systems: Computer Vision, Image Processing, Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)
